entry.title: New: dsh-explorer#dsh-explorer
entry.summary: Git-first file-tree sidebar for the DSH web GUI: VS Code-style indent guides, M/A/U/D/R git decorations, HEAD-vs-worktree diff preview, media preview, and drag-to-reference (files/folders/selected code with line numbers) — pure plugin. Exact install spec: github:no-prm/dsh-explorer#path:/dsh-plugins/dsh-explorer. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
